messages:
Ashley K.: Heads-up: I'm carving out 90 minutes tomorrow AM to do a light sweep of docs/runbooks and the playbooks folder for stale links and tiny clarity edits. Goal: fix high-impact 404s and any examples that fail ci.
Sam T.: Appreciate it. I noticed a broken shortlink in onboarding-playbook that causes the quickstart curl to 403 for new hires. I can open a tiny PR if you want me to own that.
Ashley K.: Please do @Sam T.  include the failing curl output in the PR description. Example error we saw in CI: ```HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: text/plain

Access denied: asset not found```
Hema R.: I can triage redirects after the PRs land. Also, if any runbook references private S3 links, swap to our canonical shortlink pattern `/kb/` or rehost behind the docs CDN.
Sam T.: Opening PR now, minimal change: swap shortlink -> canonical `/kb/onboarding/quickstart` and update curl snippet to use the shortlink. PR: https://git.internal.redwood/p/docs/merge/1299
Ashley K.: Thanks. Quick ask to reviewers: keep the changes atomic (single link edits) so they land cleanly. If you see images with 403s while editing, add a comment and tag @Hema R. so she can rehost.
deploy-bot: CI check started for PR 1299. Status: link-scan running.
Sam T.: CI reported one other low-severity redirect warning in `/playbooks/runtime/ops.md` (old anchor). I'll include a redirect-friendly anchor replacement in the same PR.
Ashley K.: Sounds good. After PRs merge, I'll run a staging smoke: curl examples + a quick spot-check of runbook index. Planning to mark verified links in the runbook index doc.
Hema R.: If anyone is short on cycles, I'm happy to pick up a second pass review tomorrow afternoon. Also can help churn alt text edits for any diagrams.
Sam T.: PR merged. Link-scan passed. https://git.internal.redwood/p/docs/commit/abc123
Ashley K.: Legendary, thanks @Sam T. and @Hema R. I'll schedule the staging smoke at 11am PT and will post results here. If we see any regressions post-merge, we'll open a follow-up tiny PR rather than trying bulk edits.
Ashley K.: (11:22am) Staging smoke: all curl examples in the touched files returned 200. Marking runbook entries as verified and closing the mini-sweep.
Hema R.: Noted: one hosted-arch image had missing alt text; opened PR to add alt: https://git.internal.redwood/p/docs/merge/1301
Ashley K.: Thanks. Closing thread — great quick turnaround!
